what_was_built: apps/ire/vq2_didone.py — a direct Didone construction system (cap/x-height/stem/hairline/serif/overshoot parameters, ellipse-ring bowls, hairline slab serifs, ball terminals, arches) plus 13 glyph builders that author outlines in final document coordinates.

contract_compliance_that_holds.width_solved_by: designed advance widths + optical gaps only

why_it_fails: Letterform quality is not acceptable. The rendered glyphs are mechanical blobs rather than coherent Didone letterforms.

Counters are not reliably punched: glyphs whose ink is several separate subpaths (R = stem + bowl + leg, m = three stems + two arches) lose parts to the fill heuristic, so bowls and counters are malformed.
Placement is wrong: the baseline mapping drove the artwork to the bottom canvas edge and clipped it, so composition targets were never actually met.
Serif and terminal language is not visually consistent across the set.
stop_conditions_met: direct construction did not meet the target composition
honest_assessment: The construction SYSTEM is sound in principle and satisfies every derivation rule the contract cares about. What it does not yet produce is letterforms of acceptable visual quality. Authoring a credible condensed Didone across 13 glyphs is real type-design work and my first pass did not reach it. Presenting this as a candidate would repeat exactly the failure this workstream has been removing.
deliverables_not_produced: dual typography inspections (gated behind deterministic pass, which was not reached)
next_options: iterate the construction system on glyph quality and the fill/placement defects before any inspection
or commission a human designer using the existing package
or licence a natively condensed Didone (Path B)
